Messages.Author: Jan Willem Wijsman
Messages.Body:
What happens if a minion dodges and the opposing minion plays scorpion
sting? Does the dodging minion get another strike or lose his strike?
I also heard there were some new errata, like 'wake with evening...' is
not replaced until your next untap phase. Is this true, and can anyone
tell me where I could find these errata?
Thanks, Jan-Willem

Messages.Author: Robert Ekvall
Messages.Body:
Jan Willem Wijsman wrote:
>
> What happens if a minion dodges and the opposing minion plays scorpion
> sting? Does the dodging minion get another strike or lose his strike?

The dodging minions strike is cancelled. He tries to dodge but fails.

> I also heard there were some new errata, like 'wake with evening...'is
> not replaced until your next untap phase. Is this true, and can anyone
> tell me where I could find these errata?

It is true; you can find the rulings (which affect more cards than that)
here but there is probably a better site somewhere:
Http://www.deckserver.net/docs/rulings.7.7
and
Http://www.deckserver.net/docs/rulings.6.23

Robert

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jan Willem Wijsman wrote:
>
> What happens if a minion dodges and the opposing minion plays scorpion
> sting? Does the dodging minion get another strike or lose his strike?

Neither. He still strikes: dodge. The scorpion sting is not cancelled
by the dodge, so the dodger still takes damage.

> I also heard there were some new errata, like 'wake with evening...' is
> not replaced until your next untap phase. Is this true, and can anyone
> tell me where I could find these errata?

It is true.

The complete list of all errata (and a list of rulings and a list
of clarifications) can be found linked from WotC's VTES Rules page
(see .sig below). A copy of the text messages posted to this newsgroup
containing the recent errata and rulings and clarifications can be
found on a player's personal page: http://members.tripod.com/~Lasombra/
